subject.title: ci(mantis): add web UI chat proof lane

question: Should this new Mantis web UI chat workflow land before trusted workflow-dispatch and publish proof exists?
rationale: The patch shape is coherent, but the remaining unproven behavior is a security- and automation-sensitive Actions publish boundary that cannot be fully exercised from this fork before the workflow exists on the default branch.

options.title: Require trusted proof first
options.body: Run the workflow from a maintainer-owned or default-registered path and require redacted run logs or published artifact evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept inspected workflow risk
options.body: Merge based on source review, CI, and Docker proof while explicitly owning any dispatch, artifact, or publish-secret failure discovered after merge.

options.title: Use a maintainer branch
options.body: Adopt the same change on a maintainer-owned branch if fork workflow restrictions keep blocking the missing proof on this PR.

recommendation.title: Require trusted proof first
recommendation.body: Run the workflow from a maintainer-owned or default-registered path and require redacted run logs or published artifact evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest current-main history on the Mantis dispatcher, publisher, docs, and Control UI E2E helper surfaces involved in the proof decision.
